items.title: Texas Instruments (TXN) Remains A Preferred Pick Despite Chip Oversupply Risk
items.summary: UBS highlighted a fresh semiconductor oversupply risk on 24 November 2026, while keeping Texas Instruments (NasdaqGS:TXN) as a preferred stock. The bank pointed to rising chip inventories across manufacturers, indicating shipments may be running ahead of end-customer demand. UBS framed Texas Instruments as relatively well positioned within the sector despite the oversupply concern affecting the wider chip market. items.title: Could Monolithic Power Stock Drop 30% Again?
items.summary: The one number a Monolithic Power Systems holder should watch is free cash flow. That is the cash left after running the business and paying for new equipment. Over the twelve months to September 2026 it came to $606 million, down from $705 million a year earlier. Revenue rose 40.5% over the same twelve months.
